rows.reason: C2R1 retains a removable static-sealed P003↔P007 interface.
Pilot locates radially, metal faces axially, one hole clocks, 3 screws clamp, O-ring seals.
Ø14.10 H7/g6 and mating face are verified; one clamp-hole axis is used only for clocking.
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-ACT-FORCE-001
For 200–300 N/screw candidate preload, thread strip SF is ≥3.10 at 300 N/screw; conservative local strip-bending screen is ≈135.6 MPa at 300 N/screw vs 170 MPa 316L screening yield.
Historical λ1=1883.6 is strong but must be refreshed on final geometry.
Two-pin P006 face-drive candidate has low nominal pin stresses at 0.5 N·m structural tool capacity; actual P006 seating torque remains process-controlled.
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-SERVICE-CYCLES-001
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-SEAL-001
No released locking method yet.
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-MEDIA-001, REQ-K01-SEAL-001, REQ-K01-LEAK-001
External J2 flange package does not change the controlled sample-flow/rod wetted geometry.
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-ACT-FORCE-001
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-MEDIA-001
C2R1 functional chains are treated as worst-case assembly/interface stacks; pilot/head and fastener-pattern stacks currently pass at study tolerances.
Round OD33, reamed/turned locating features and 3-hole pattern are simple. Small M2.5 tapping in 316L and P006 Ø1.5 blind service holes need shop capability confirmation.
Native verify PASS with 0 active mate errors and no new hard interference.
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-SEAL-001, REQ-K01-SERVICE-CYCLES-001
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-LEAK-001, REQ-K01-ACT-FORCE-001
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-SERVICE-CYCLES-001
Blocked by requirement(s): REQ-K01-MEDIA-001, REQ-K01-LEAK-001
Size/classes are selected; exact M2.5 finish/lubrication and FFKM supplier compound are open.

OD33 round turned flange and 3 screws minimize machining. FFKM is expensive but one small safety-critical seal has low system-level cost; FKM remains an application-approved cost-down option only after media compatibility proof.

MEDTAS v8 separates nominal CAD geometry, released allowable variation, decision rationale, verification evidence and derived state; Drawing Intent implements design-intent-to-inspection traceability.

rows.statement: Final electromagnetic design shall meet or exceed the released minimum force/force-coefficient envelope over stroke, current, temperature and production tolerances.
